landscape.narration: This design closes a visibility gap in the odyssey viewer: a build's Gate 3 program design and Gate 4b epic designs stay invisible to the one surface built to show build progress, so someone reviewing a build has to leave the viewer to read them.
landscape.tagline: Show the gate document, not just the gate's approval state.

problem_solution.narration: The Builds view already shows a Gate Rail of approval state, keyed off 00-status.md. It never carries the document behind each gate. A reviewer who wants to read Gate 3 has no path from the viewer to the doc, and the one-off fix — publishing the doc as a Claude Artifact — drifts from the source and is not discoverable from the viewer itself.
problem_solution.problem: Gate 3 and Gate 4b documents exist under docs/plans/<slug>/ but have no entity in the viewer's index, so they never appear in the Builds view no matter how often the bundle rebuilds.
problem_solution.solution: Project the two document types into two new index entities, program_design and epic_design, then make the Gate Rail cards and epic cards that already exist in the Builds view open a sheet showing that content.

beats.text: A colleague session tried to open the viewer mid-Gate-3 and found nothing there. The Gate Rail's approval-state chrome was current; the document behind it was not indexed at all.

The Builds view already has the join key a gate doc needs — feature_slug for a program design, epic id for an epic design. Attach the doc to the card that already represents that build, instead of building a new surface to hold it.

alternatives.rejected: ADR-0018 decided one lifecycle surface. A gate doc is scoped to a build already shown in Builds.

alternatives.option: Parse gate docs client-side, skipping the index
alternatives.rejected: The viewer is one committed HTML file with no filesystem access beyond its bundled data/ scripts.

alternatives.option: Execute ADR-0020's viewer-parts split as part of this design
alternatives.rejected: ADR-0020 is decided but not executed. Starting that execution here is scope this design does not own.

alternatives.option: Keep publishing gate docs as one-off Artifacts
alternatives.rejected: No rebuild hook, drifts from docs/plans/, undiscoverable from the viewer — the problem this design fixes.

architecture.narration: shared/build_index.py gains two field-projection constants and two loader functions, following the same project_fields(source, fields) shape every other entity already uses. The viewer gains a sheet, reusing openAdrSheet's pattern, wired to the Gate Rail and epic cards that renderBuildsMainContent already renders.

beats.text: The viewer stays one self-contained file today, so this attaches to plugins/artifact/viewer/index.html directly, not to a future viewer/src/ split.
program_design keys on feature_slug, matching joins.feature_gates. epic_design keys on epic id, matching entities.epic. No new join table.
Read-only. No editing a gate doc from the viewer, no change to how 00-status.md's approval state itself is parsed or displayed.
